subject.title: Feature Request: Token Usage API for session_status Tool

question: Should raw token, cost, and quota usage become part of `session_status.details`, move into a separate agent-facing usage tool, or remain only on Gateway/operator usage surfaces for now?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-confirmed, but the public API boundary affects privacy, session visibility, source/freshness semantics, provider cost metadata, and compatibility for agent tools.

options.title: Add structured session_status usage
options.body: Extend `session_status.details` with stable session, last-turn, budget/window, source, freshness, and unavailable metadata while preserving the rendered status card.

options.title: Create a separate usage tool
options.body: Keep `session_status` display-oriented and add a narrower agent-facing usage query tool that reuses Gateway and transcript parsers under the same visibility guards.

options.title: Keep raw usage operator-only
options.body: Leave raw usage on Gateway and operator surfaces until the broader usage-ledger and freshness-metadata designs settle.

recommendation.title: Add structured session_status usage
recommendation.body: Extend `session_status.details` with stable session, last-turn, budget/window, source, freshness, and unavailable metadata while preserving the rendered status card.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history on `session_status` and the prior structured-usage review context.
